topics.label: Introduction to cancer biology and lecture aims
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with an overview of course themes, learning outcomes, and the clinical significance of cancer biology.

topics.label: Biological foundations, tissue architecture, and cell culture models of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through genetic and differentiation failures within complex tissue architectures, alongside the experimental limitations of modeling these processes in cell culture.

topics.label: Pathology and dissemination of benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the mechanisms of local invasion and metastatic dissemination while contrasting the macroscopic and histological features of benign and malignant lesions.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and clinical risks of benign lesions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the multi-step histological transition from benign precursor adenomas to invasive carcinomas and explain the clinical hazards presented by non-invasive growths.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the anatomical and histological naming conventions used to categorize benign and malignant neoplasms across diverse tissue lineages.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the physiological and anatomical mechanisms by which primary and metastatic tumors impair normal tissue function and cause patient mortality.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across humans and animal species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse cancer incidence and mortality patterns in human populations alongside comparative oncology observations across companion animals and multicellular taxa.

topics.label: Clinical detection and screening strategies across cancer types
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review clinical signs of cancer and evaluate the principles, diagnostic effectiveness, and limitations of population screening programmes across various organ sites.

topics.label: Closing remarks and practical preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture concludes with a review of the learning outcomes and a preview of upcoming practical sessions.
